turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 배추 이백 포기 왔어. 오늘 다 해치워야 해.
turns.rd: baechu ibaek pogi wasseo. oneul da haechiwoya hae.
turns.en: Two hundred heads of cabbage just got here. We gotta finish all of it today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Two hundred heads? For real? In one day?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 응. 할머니 친구분들이랑 이모들도 다 오신대.
turns.rd: eung. halmeoni chingubundeurirang imodeuldo da osindae.
turns.en: Yeah. Grandma’s friends and the aunts are all coming too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: (gloves) Is this much seasoning okay? It’s a lot.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 더 팍팍! 손 아끼지 말고 얼굴에도 묻혀!
turns.rd: deo pakpak! son akkiji malgo eolguredo mutyeo!
turns.en: Slap on more! Don’t hold back, get it on your face too!

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: (얼굴에 튀어서) 헐! 진짜 매워! 근데 맛있다…
turns.rd: (eolgure twieoseo) heol! jinjja maewo! geunde masitda…
turns.en: (splashes face) Whoa! It’s so spicy! But it tastes good…

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: ㅋㅋ 양념 얼굴에 다 묻었네. 이제 진짜 김장 멤버다.
turns.rd: ㅋㅋ yangnyeom eolgure da mudeonne. ije jinjja gimjang membeoda.
turns.en: Lol your face is covered in seasoning. Now you’re a real kimjang member.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 수육 먹고 시작하자. 배고프면 못 해. 옆집 아줌마도 온대.
turns.rd: suyuk meokgo sijakaja. baegopeumyeon mot hae. yeopjip ajummado ondae.
turns.en: Let’s eat the pork first. Can’t work if we’re hungry. Neighbor lady’s coming too.
